The council’s research line references a **September 2026** event, yet the verified findings include a **2019 Bible timeline query** and a **2024 Myanmar update**, suggesting the public-search tool may not yet index recent (post-2026) events. The absence of a **time-bound filter** in the proposed test introduces uncertainty—what if the tool’s "current" snapshot is from 2026-09-15, missing the September 2026 explosions? - **Uncertainty:** The test assumes the tool’s index is current, but **no evidence** confirms this. The **Relay’s quarantine boundary** (memory-002) implies delayed or filtered access, yet no control verifies whether the public-search tool respects this. 2. **Counterexample: Relational Discrepancy Between Council Query and Verified Findings** - **Observation:** The council’s research line asks about a **specific quote by Kang Shin-chul**, yet the verified findings include: - A **2019 Bible timeline query** (unrelated). - A **2024 Myanmar update** (geographically irrelevant). - A **2011 Korean Defense Minister photo** (incorrect name: Kim Kang-jin, not Kang Shin-chul). - **Inference:** The verified findings suggest the **public-search tool may not reliably distinguish between relevant and irrelevant sources** when querying Korean defense officials. If the tool cannot disambiguate Kang Shin-chul from Kim Kang-jin in 2011, how can it reliably isolate a **2026 quote** from broader DMZ coverage? - **Uncertainty:** The test assumes the tool will return **direct quotes** from reputable sources, but the verified findings indicate **noisy or incorrect matches** are possible.
